Private Events

Where the magic of Baja sets the stage for every celebration.

Nestled within Marina Village at Costa Palmas, Mozza Baja is a vibrant destination for private events and group celebrations. With stunning marina views, glowing sunsets, and a relaxed Baja-chic atmosphere, it's the perfect backdrop for unforgettable occasions.

Whether you're planning a welcome dinner, milestone birthday, wedding weekend, or corporate gathering, our team brings together exceptional food, warm hospitality, and the easy, sun-soaked spirit of Baja.

Event Menus

Curated by
Chef Nancy

Inspired by the celebrated Mozza restaurants of Los Angeles — Pizzeria Mozza, Chi Spacca, and the Michelin-starred Osteria Mozza — our menus highlight bold, wood-fired cooking, fresh local seafood, and pizzas pulled straight from our wood-burning oven, made with our signature house dough.

Family Style

Abundant platters to gather around the table — pizzas, pastas, and shareable plates served generously.

Tray-Passed Bites

Elegant small plates served seamlessly throughout your event for easy, mingling-friendly dining.

Cocktails

A curated selection of wine, craft cocktails, and bright Baja spritzes to set the mood.

View Menus
Furniture & Setup

Baja-inspired style

Mozza Baja's eclectic, colorful furnishings create a warm and inviting setting, perfect for gatherings of all sizes. Large communal tables, bar seating, and marina-front terraces set the stage for a lively, stylish event.

  • For partial buyouts, our in-house furniture is included.
  • For full buyouts or custom décor, additional rentals and setup costs may apply.
Event Spaces & Layout

Explore the possibilities

From intimate dinners to large-scale celebrations, Mozza Baja offers versatile event spaces across the restaurant, terrace, and marina esplanade.

Up to 50 guests
Partial Buyout

Terrace seating in front of the bar — an intimate setting ideal for dinners and smaller celebrations within the Mozza atmosphere.

Up to 220 guests
Full Buyout

Chiki Nightclub

The night continues

Carry the celebration on at Chiki, a speakeasy-style nightclub inspired by the spirit and architecture of Mexico City's La Casa Azul. Designed by the acclaimed Martin Brudnizki Design Studio, the space fuses raw authenticity with modern Mexican flair — crafted cocktails, a DJ-driven atmosphere, and eclectic design that carries the night well past dinner.

  • Maximum capacity: 120 guests
  • Buyout available, with furniture included
  • Cocktails & small bites available
